nodes.label: Dataset Question isActive Approval Guard
nodes.rationale: CoreBankQuestion refuses isActive:true unless approvalStatus is approved, so no question reaches a parent by accident.

nodes.label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.
nodes.norm_label: cdc learn the signs. act early.

nodes.label: Source Licence Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Settle first: a negative licence answer changes what the rest of the work is for.

nodes.label: Parental Concern & Skill Regression Items
nodes.rationale: Both carry independent signal and must route outside domain scoring rather than be averaged in.

nodes.label: DQ09 Open Mapping Question ('at least three')

nodes.label: Iles-Caven et al. (2016), Data in Brief 9:112-122
nodes.norm_label: iles-caven et al. (2016), data in brief 9:112-122

nodes.label: Global 'Answer From What You Have Seen' Instruction
nodes.norm_label: global 'answer from what you have seen' instruction
nodes.rationale: Resolves DQ16 and future physical items at once and stops parents coaching children to pass; not implemented because it lands in unreviewed parent-facing text.

nodes.label: ML Directory Never Operational
nodes.rationale: Zero trained-model records and no model file at audit time; prediction path always fell back to rules. Retained for transparency and labelled 'Experimental - not used for live screening results'.

nodes.label: Model Activation (Document Gate, Smoke Test, Swap)
nodes.norm_label: model activation (document gate, smoke test, swap)

nodes.label: Model Rollback / Switching
nodes.rationale: Rollback reuses the activation path so it gets the same smoke test; nothing is deleted on deactivation.

nodes.label: Model v4 Metrics (~63% Accuracy)
nodes.rationale: ~63% vs 33% baseline is the honest ceiling; 99% would indicate leakage of score cutoffs into labels.

nodes.label: -1 Not-Administered Sentinel Applied at Train Time
nodes.norm_label: -1 not-administered sentinel applied at train time

nodes.label: Answer Encoding (2/1/0, blank = not administered)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors scoreAnswer() exactly; collapsing 'sometimes' to binary would discard information the app preserves; blank distinguishes age-gated from 'no'.

nodes.label: Rule-Derived Training Labels (Circular Learning)
nodes.rationale: Generating labels from the rule engine's cutoffs makes a model memorise the if/else logic; near-100% accuracy would say nothing about child development.

nodes.label: Class-First Sampling & ~18% Label Perturbation
nodes.rationale: Avoids target leakage: risk_category is never a threshold function of the scores, so a model cannot just re-learn a cutoff rule.

nodes.label: Legacy Band Docs & bandComparabilityWarning
nodes.rationale: Bands recomputed from stored score via bandFor() to put all children on one ruler; defensive signals disclose unstamped documents.

nodes.label: Five Pre-Unification Cutoff Sets
nodes.rationale: Five independent cutoff sets disagreed about the same child (62% = Developing / on-track / focus area / low risk), motivating a single source of truth.

nodes.label: riskLevel/overallRisk Exhaustive Verification
nodes.rationale: All 101 scores checked: 78 unchanged, 23 more urgent, 0 less urgent - monotonically conservative.

nodes.label: getSuggestedNextAssessmentDate Open Clinical Question
nodes.rationale: 40/60 literals select follow-up intervals, not bands; mapping to bands is a clinical judgement, so left un-unified.

nodes.label: Scoring Bands Backfill Report
nodes.rationale: APPLY run restamped 11 result docs to v2-80/60/40; 7 status fields changed; riskFlags and scores untouched.

nodes.label: ACTIVE_BANDS 80/60/40
nodes.rationale: Chosen because parents already saw it (no parent-facing change) and it errs toward over-referral; provenance unconfirmed, not clinically validated.

nodes.label: Pay at Clinic QR / Walk-in Option
nodes.norm_label: pay at clinic qr / walk-in option

nodes.label: Family Management Section (Linked Guardians / Add Family Member)
nodes.norm_label: family management section (linked guardians / add family member)

nodes.label: On-Behalf-Of Pediatrician Banner
nodes.rationale: Makes clear the secretary acts on behalf of a linked pediatrician.

nodes.label: Banker's Rounding Provenance Finding
nodes.rationale: overall_score matched Python round-half-to-even on 60/60 rows but JS Math.round on only 45/60, proving the demo CSV came from a Python generator, not KinderCura.

nodes.label: Models Trained Counter Correction
nodes.rationale: Counter read a dataset status flag set on upload registration; now reads the trained-model collection directly (0).

nodes.label: TrainingDataset status trained -> registered
nodes.rationale: Only datasets with no modelId and no TrainedModel were migrated, so the database stops asserting something untrue.

nodes.label: --app-rounding (Math.round) Generator Option
nodes.rationale: Python round() is half-to-even and moved ~19% of rows by one point versus the app's Math.round.

nodes.label: KinderCura Folder Structure (server.js, routes, middleware, role pages)
nodes.norm_label: kindercura folder structure (server.js, routes, middleware, role pages)

nodes.label: SQL Server (SQLEXPRESS02) Legacy Database Setup
nodes.rationale: v3.0 guide instructs running database/schema.sql in SSMS against SQL Server; appears superseded by MongoDB Atlas elsewhere in the repo.

nodes.label: MONGODB_URI Environment Variable
nodes.rationale: Atlas connection string kept out of source control; set per Vercel environment (Preview/Production/Development); db.js supports SRV and non-SRV forms.

nodes.label: KinderCura v3.0 How To Run Guide
nodes.norm_label: kindercura v3.0 how to run guide

nodes.label: Atlas IP Access for Serverless Hosts
nodes.norm_label: atlas ip access for serverless hosts
nodes.rationale: Vercel has no fixed outbound IPs, so Atlas commonly allows 0.0.0.0/0 or uses VPC peering.

nodes.label: loadScope() Central Filtering
nodes.rationale: All filters applied once so charts, tables and CSV cannot describe different patient sets; one $in query per collection.

nodes.label: Overall Score as Unweighted Mean of Domains
nodes.norm_label: overall score as unweighted mean of domains

nodes.label: Unequal Per-Item Domain Weighting
nodes.rationale: Domains have 13/9/6/6 items, so a Cognitive item moves the overall ~2.17x a Motor item; a side effect of the unweighted mean, not a clinical choice.

nodes.label: Pediatrician Reports Module
nodes.rationale: Read-only descriptive reporting over stored rule-based scores; never recomputes scores to avoid a second scoring path.

nodes.label: Latest-Screening-Per-Child Counting
nodes.rationale: One child, one count, so a child screened four times does not outweigh three screened once.

nodes.label: Appointment-Based Patient Scope
nodes.rationale: A child is in scope iff an Appointment links them to req.user.userId; status ignored to match My Patients; no client-supplied pediatrician id.

nodes.label: Structured Clinical Outcome Field (clinicalOutcome)
nodes.rationale: Added because the only free-text diagnosis was 'Yes please'; a structured, independent clinician conclusion is the only valid training label.

nodes.label: Outcome Cross-Tab Removal (2026-09-29)
nodes.rationale: clinicalOutcome set on 0 of 1,716 assessments, so the section only ever showed its empty state.

nodes.label: Prerequisites Before Any ML Claim
nodes.rationale: Collect real labels, reach hundreds of samples, stop rule-derived labels, hold out a test set, report confusion matrix, beat the rule baseline.

nodes.label: No Validation Metrics Policy
nodes.rationale: No accuracy/sensitivity/PPV etc.: tiny sample, non-blinded labels, and unconfirmed cutoffs each independently make such figures misleading.

nodes.label: Real Labeled Outcomes Required for Clinical Validity
nodes.norm_label: real labeled outcomes required for clinical validity
nodes.rationale: Synthetic data proves the pipeline is technically functional, not clinically valid; models must be described as pipeline demonstrations.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Screening System
nodes.rationale: Transparent clinician-informed rules are auditable: every result traces to a specific answer and threshold, which matters in pediatrics. The risk is describing the system as ML when it is not.

nodes.label: No Fabricated Clinical Judgements in Synthetic Data
nodes.norm_label: no fabricated clinical judgements in synthetic data

nodes.label: Batch-Namespaced syntheticObjectId
nodes.rationale: Batch must be part of the SHA-1 address or a second batch silently overwrites the first batch's users.

nodes.label: Synthetic Pediatrician Booking-List Filter
nodes.rationale: Synthetic pediatricians cannot log in, so a real parent booking one would be a dead end; SHOW_SYNTHETIC_PEDIATRICIANS_TO_PARENTS for local dev only.

nodes.label: Requirement A: Synthetic System Demo Data (1,500 users)
nodes.norm_label: requirement a: synthetic system demo data (1,500 users)

nodes.label: Synthetic Data Safety Contract
nodes.rationale: Local and production share one Atlas database, so marking (isSynthetic), deterministic addressing, collision guards, purge-only-synthetic and reserved counters are enforced in code.

nodes.label: app-dev README (placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Root README is leftover personal placeholder content (favorite series) and does not describe KinderCura.

nodes.label: Root Python Dependencies (scikit-learn, pandas, joblib, numpy)
nodes.norm_label: root python dependencies (scikit-learn, pandas, joblib, numpy)

nodes.label: Deliberate Defect Injection (--defect-rate)
nodes.rationale: A generator emitting only perfect rows makes the cleaning stage untestable; counted injected faults let cleaning counts be reconciled.

nodes.label: Normalization Off by Default
nodes.rationale: RandomForest is scale-invariant; min-max scaling would change nothing while breaking the 'columns are percentages' contract.

nodes.label: window.KCScoring (score ranges, loaded before page scripts)
nodes.norm_label: window.kcscoring (score ranges, loaded before page scripts)

nodes.label: Model Dataset Pipeline (Generate & Clean)
nodes.rationale: Calls the same endpoint as the Training page's Process button so there is one training path, not two.

nodes.label: System Demo Data (Read-only)
nodes.rationale: Demo data generation is a CLI command (scripts/generate-system-demo-data.js), never a button, so 1,500 accounts can't be created/deleted by a stray click.

nodes.label: Most Common Pediatrician Diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Ground truth is Assessment.diagnosis (pediatrician free text), never clinicalOutcome; mode computed server-side.

nodes.label: Demographic Profile of Late Development
nodes.rationale: 'Late development' = Delayed band only (constants/scoring.js BAND.DELAYED); no new backend aggregation.

nodes.label: Model Activation Confirmation (Smoke Test)
nodes.rationale: Custom modal instead of confirm() so the admin sees smoke-test results; Confirm stays disabled until the smoke test passes.

nodes.label: Stratified 80/20 Train-Test Split
nodes.rationale: Metrics measure agreement with synthetic rule-generated labels; definitions match ml/trainer.py.

nodes.label: Secretary Accounts Managed by Pediatrician
nodes.rationale: Assistant/Secretary accounts are created by each Pediatrician via Settings > Staff Access, not by admins.

nodes.norm_label: check-up / medical history modal (longitudinal, specialist referral)
